newsitem.title: USA: CME pork bellies sink near limit on weak cash,stop.
newsitem.headline: CME pork bellies sink near limit on weak cash,stop.

text.p: CME pork belly futures continued tumbled almost their 3.000-cent-per-lb daily limits in nearby months on slipping cash belly prices and sell stops, traders said.
May was down 2.925 cents at 87.650 cents per lb and July fell to 88.825, off 2.825 cents. Other months fell 2.525 to 0.050.

Falling cash belly prices weighed on futures with scale-down sell stops adding to loses. Cash bellies have fallen to the mid $80-per-cwt level after recently rising to $90. Some traders said prices could fall to $80 or less before tapping into renewed domestic buying.
